Attend the performance of [[Norgu]]'s play "Norgu's Nightfall."

== Quest information ==
=== Requirements ===
* [[Norgu]] must be present to continue.

=== Objectives ===
* Watch "Norgu's Nightfall" while it is performed for Academy consideration.
* Find out if "Norgu's Nightfall" gets nominated.
* Attend the Entertainment Academy awards show.
* Receive the "Greatest Play in [[Vabbi]] and, Indeed, the Whole World" award.
* See [[Prince Bokka the Magnificent]] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* 10 [[Lightbringer Points]]

== Walkthrough ==
Leaving from [[The Kodash Bazaar]] makes the trip shorter.
Then just travel a short distance to 'attend the performance'.

When it is done, map to The Kodash Bazaar and speak with [[Records Keeper Palin]] for an update. Map to [[Honur Hill]] and walk to the [[Bokka Amphitheatre]]. Talk to [[Bahskir]] for your update to see Prince Bokka the Magnificent for your reward.

== Dialogue ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
;[[Korvus]]
: ''"Well played, friends. Well played. I am a member of Norgu's acting troupe, the infamous [[Lyssan Fools]]. Norgu has recently completed his magnum opus, "Norgu's Nightfall," roughly based on your adventures with him. He's called the troupe together to perform it for Academy consideration. If we win this award, we shall be the most celebrated entertainers in Vabbi. Nay, the entire world! It would mean a great deal to us, and especially Norgu, if you, the original cast and crew, could '''attend''' the performance at the '''Grand Forum of Vabb'''."''

== Notes ==
* Although the initial dialogue does not indicate Norgu as a requirement for the whole quest, there will be pauses during the performance of the play, where his comments would be, and the objectives will state that Norgu must be present to continue.
** If you are near the "play" without Norgu in your party, the remaining dialogue will continue, including the acted "Norgu".  Only the actual Norgu's dialogue will be missing.

* However you '''do''' need to have Norgu in your party at the "Receive the "Greatest Play in Vabbi, and Indeed, the Whole World" award." part of the quest, because if that condition is not fulfilled, you will not be able to talk to Bashkir to receive the award.  Parties should ensure that Norgu is at least present before entering Resplendent Makuun to attend the awards ceremony.

* When "Abaddon" is "killed" he leaves a corpse that can be exploited.

* If anyone on the team has the first stage of this quest active [[Butoh the Bold]] will not spawn near the [[Font of Lyss]] for the primary quest, [[Attack at the Kodash]], to continue.

== Trivia ==
* The dialogue of [[The Shrine of Maat]] quest mentions Norgu's Nightfall.
* The line "We few, we happy few! We band of heroes! For he today who sheds his blood with me shall be forever remembered a hero on Nightfall Day!" is a parody of [[w:Henry V _(play)|Henry V]] by [[w:William Shakespeare|William Shakespeare]].
* The three competing nominees for "The Greatest Play in Vabbi" are all references to real movies: [[W:Lord of the Rings|Lord of the Rings]] (Lord of the Strings), [[W:Snakes on a Plane|Snakes on a Plane]] (Drakes on a Plain), and [[W:The Producers (1968 film)|Springtime for Hitler]] (Summertime for Bokka).
* Part of the narrator's first line in the intermediate dialogue is from the starting cinematics for new characters in the Nightfall campaign.  In fact, the entire "play" closely parallels the story line the character follows through out completion of the campaign.
* At the end of the play and after recieving the reward, the cast dances with the following animations:
** Narrator, "Abaddon", and "Hero" - male Ranger dance
** "Kormir" and "Varesh" - female Elementalist dance
** "Norgu" - male Warrior dance
* The watching Vabbian nobles also show their appreciation with applause by way of the /clap emote.
